reconstruction_summary: Reproduced V3 (per-segment bias + K_us understeer correction + first-order steering-lag tau via grid search) from out/analyse.py; predict = (v/L)*tan(delta_filt) - bias - K_us*pred*v^2, with parameters fit per-segment as in the agent's script.
notes: V3 fits bias/K_us/tau per-segment from the same segment used for scoring (in-sample fit, as in the agent's own ladder). Lightning wheelbase L=3.70 applied for FORD_F_150_LIGHTNING_MK1 segments (agent only scored Mach-E in REPORT.md, L=2.984). Canonical sample filter is v>2 m/s; agent's own fit-time regime mask uses v>5 m/s, |delta|<0.01 for straight, |dyaw/dt|>0.5 for transient.
